title: ALTO hardware restoration can fail without failing the test run
summary: Restoration ignores move_to/hw_set failures, while those helpers return bool without incrementing the global failure count. Exact extracted restore function with all four calls false still exits0/failures0, leaving changed state while reporting success. Aggregate restoration outcomes and propagate failure while retaining cleanup; no hardware was operated. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
